settingsRules.title: Requirement prefill rules
settingsRules.summary: Expression lists grouped by category, in French and English.
settingsRules.help: Open a category to edit its keyword or heading lists. French and English lists are independent: they may contain different numbers of expressions, without automatic translation.
settingsRules.priorities: Keywords: literal expressions within a passage, not regexes. Headings: entire section or column labels. Case and accents are ignored. S1000D context and operating actions still take precedence.
settingsRules.heading: Section or column headings
settingsRules.listHelp: Add, correct or remove expressions directly in the lists, then save.
settingsRules.onePerLine: One expression per line; blank lines are ignored. French and English lists do not need the same number of lines.
settingsRules.confirmRemoval: Removing or replacing expressions requires a second click on the save button within 3 seconds.
settingsRules.required: Every active list needs French and English, at most 200 characters per expression and 1000 expressions per language in total. Clear both languages to remove a list.
settingsRules.saved: Rules saved in the local database — revision {{revision}}.
settingsRules.unsaved: Unsaved changes: click "Save rules" before leaving.
settingsRules.changedElsewhere: Another save changed these rules. Reload before saving; your local edits have not been discarded automatically.
settingsRules.impact: Rules apply to this entire local installation and survive document resets. Effective changes make previous reviews stale without deleting decisions. Resume the document and explicitly restart its review. Rules never confirm classifications for you.

errors.RULES_CONFLICT: Rules changed in another window. Reload before saving.
errors.RULES_DUPLICATE: An expression occurs more than once in a list, or a category/type group is repeated.
errors.RULES_TOO_MANY: The limit of 1000 expressions per language has been exceeded.
errors.RULES_CATEGORY_CONFLICT: The same expression cannot belong to two categories for the same detection type.
errors.RULES_RESERVED_HEADING: S1000D structure headings (procedure, closing, common information…) remain protected.
errors.VALIDATION_ERROR: Invalid lists: every active group needs valid French and English expressions.
